key_insight: OpenPINN/PINO unifies physics-informed neural networks and neural operators through shared specifications, extensible components, and agent-assisted setup and diagnosis.
engineering_relevance: The open-source PyTorch framework supports controlled solver comparisons and reusable workflows for engineering PDE problems.
method: ProblemSpec defines geometry, physics, parameters, constraints, and optional data.
MethodSpec configures models, sampling, losses, optimization, and differentiation for deterministic local code generation.
Agents translate problem descriptions, flag missing information, propose solver plans, and diagnose results.
evidence_signal: Across three examples, selected methods reduced Burgers error by about 75% and periodic Poisson error by about 68% over 16 held-out forcings; agent-guided plate-with-hole revisions achieved 3.51%–6.31% displacement error in three runs.
watch_item: Evidence is limited to three example problems; broader robustness and the reliability of agent-generated specifications require further validation.
paper_title: OpenPINN/PINO: An Extensible Open-Source Framework for Agent-Assisted Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Neural Operators
